scripts.build: (cd apps/api && go build ./...) && (cd apps/worker && go build ./...) && npm --workspace apps/web run build
scripts.test: (cd apps/api && go test ./...) && (cd apps/worker && go test ./...) && npm --workspace apps/web run test
scripts.lint: (cd apps/api && go test ./...) && (cd apps/worker && go test ./...) && npm --workspace apps/web run lint
scripts.dev: echo 'Run API: cd apps/api && go run ./cmd/api ; Run Worker: cd apps/worker && go run ./cmd/worker ; Run Web: npm --workspace apps/web run dev'
